boundary_certificate.achievement: The first full-line sequential stationary correction cancels coefficientwise for an arbitrary twice-differentiable amplitude. For the physical ideal cubic it is exactly the cancellation of the reciprocal correction to mathcal F against the saddle symbol of mathcal J.
boundary_certificate.finite_cell_boundary: The proof uses the full-line Gaussian moment coefficients at one continuous reciprocal saddle. The exact discrete half-open cell has integer boundary transfers which are not bounded here.
boundary_certificate.handoff: Derive an exact finite reciprocal-cell identity with the two endpoint transfers exposed. Subtract the returned physical carrier and the cancelling first correction, then bound the remaining cell defect in a form that is summable across q without absolute family aggregation.
boundary_certificate.incomplete_fresnel_boundary: The physical u integral has incomplete Fresnel endpoints. Their tails, the lower and upper endpoint packages, and boundary q=1,B cells must be recomposed before the full-line cancellation becomes a finite theorem.
boundary_certificate.next_defect: In the complete-line interior symbol the order-alpha_P^(-1) correction vanishes, so the next formal interior term begins at second correction order. No O(alpha_P^(-2)) finite-cell remainder is claimed until the discrete boundaries and incomplete Fresnel tails are bounded.

proof_boundary: This gate proves the exact half-open reciprocal cells, dual Morse phase and Jacobian, leading carrier return, equality of the two first stationary differential symbols, and their coefficientwise cancellation. It proves no finite reciprocal-cell remainder, incomplete-Fresnel or endpoint-complete h2 bound, q-family cancellation theorem, quadratic residual bound, signed flow estimate, Phi_B upper bound, contact exclusion, retained aggregate or Xi theorem, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion.

rows.claim: Nearest-integer phase derivatives define deterministic reciprocal cells.
rows.proof_boundary: Only positive modes with derivative at least 1/2 are covered.

rows.certificate: The lower derivative boundary is included and the upper is excluded, so adjacent cells are disjoint and every equality alpha_P/r=q+1/2 transfers to C_(q+1).
rows.claim: The half-open convention resolves every exact derivative tie.
rows.proof_boundary: Cell membership is combinatorial, not a phase estimate.

rows.certificate: The cells q>=1 partition every positive mode with alpha_P/r>=1/2; intersection with the fixed roster handles its at-most-one top edge.
rows.claim: The reciprocal cells partition the stationary positive roster range.

rows.certificate: For rho=qr/alpha_P, Phi_q(r)=alpha_P[log(alpha_P/r)-1]+qr=alpha_Plog q+alpha_P[rho-1-log rho]. zeta(rho)=sgn(rho-1)sqrt(2[rho-1-log rho]), eta=sqrt(alpha_P)zeta, so Phi_q=alpha_Plog q+eta^2/2.
rows.claim: Each q cell has an exact positive-sign Morse phase.
rows.proof_boundary: The discrete sum has not been replaced by an integral.

rows.certificate: dr/deta=[sqrt(alpha_P)/q]J(rho), with J(1)=1, J'(1)=2/3, and J''(1)=-5/18.
rows.claim: The reciprocal chart uses the same Morse Jacobian as the original transform.
rows.proof_boundary: Only its saddle jet is used in the correction identity.

rows.certificate: The original u chart has F_-=e(-1/8), the reciprocal r chart has F_+=e(+1/8), and F_-F_+=1.
rows.claim: The sequential Fresnel signatures cancel exactly.
rows.proof_boundary: Incomplete endpoint Fresnel factors are not full signatures.

rows.certificate: At r_*=alpha_P/q, [qA(q)/sqrt(alpha_P)][sqrt(alpha_P)/q]=A(q), so the sequential leading stationary symbol is exactly e(alpha_Plog q)A(q).
rows.claim: The sequential leading stationary symbol returns the physical q carrier with unit amplitude.
rows.proof_boundary: This is the full-line local symbol, not a discrete cell theorem.

rows.claim: One differential operator controls both first stationary corrections.
rows.proof_boundary: The amplitude must have the displayed derivatives.

rows.claim: The original negative Morse chart has an exact saddle second derivative.

rows.certificate: The reciprocal leading amplitude after its Jacobian is d_q(eta)=J(rho)A(q/rho)/rho, with d_q''(0)=mathcal D_qA/alpha_P.
rows.claim: The reciprocal leading amplitude has the matching second derivative.
The reciprocal Jacobian transports the inner second derivative exactly to the dual one.
rows.proof_boundary: No remainder estimate follows by itself.

rows.certificate: For A(q)=exp(S(log q))P(log q), mathcal D_qA=exp(S)[P''+(2g+1)P'+(g^2+g+t/2+1/6)P](log q), the same removable-saddle operator as Section 11.173.
rows.claim: For the physical amplitude the common differential symbol is exactly the removable saddle operator.
rows.proof_boundary: The joined alpha/beta row remains retained.

rows.certificate: The positive reciprocal Gaussian contributes -kappa d_q''(0)/2, while the leading transform of the negative-chart c-prime correction contributes +kappa[sqrt(alpha_P)/q]b''(0)/2; their sum is exactly zero.
rows.claim: The first sequential stationary correction cancels identically.
rows.proof_boundary: This is a full-line stationary-symbol cancellation.

rows.certificate: The first full-line sequential stationary correction cancels coefficientwise for an arbitrary twice-differentiable amplitude. For the physical ideal cubic it is exactly the cancellation of the reciprocal correction to mathcal F against the saddle symbol of mathcal J.
rows.claim: The cancellation acts between the transformed retained main and the c-prime saddle symbol.
rows.proof_boundary: It has not yet been promoted through finite cell boundaries.

rows.certificate: The proof uses the full-line Gaussian moment coefficients at one continuous reciprocal saddle. The exact discrete half-open cell has integer boundary transfers which are not bounded here.
rows.claim: Exact integer cell boundary transfers remain to be bounded.
rows.proof_boundary: No finite-cell remainder bound is claimed.

rows.certificate: The physical u integral has incomplete Fresnel endpoints. Their tails, the lower and upper endpoint packages, and boundary q=1,B cells must be recomposed before the full-line cancellation becomes a finite theorem.
rows.claim: Incomplete Fresnel and physical endpoint packages remain to be recomposed.
rows.proof_boundary: No endpoint-complete h2 estimate is claimed.

rows.certificate: In the complete-line interior symbol the order-alpha_P^(-1) correction vanishes, so the next formal interior term begins at second correction order. No O(alpha_P^(-2)) finite-cell remainder is claimed until the discrete boundaries and incomplete Fresnel tails are bounded. Derive an exact finite reciprocal-cell identity with the two endpoint transfers exposed. Subtract the returned physical carrier and the cancelling first correction, then bound the remaining cell defect in a form that is summable across q without absolute family aggregation.
rows.claim: The next formal interior correction is delayed, but its finite counterpart is still open.
rows.proof_boundary: No alpha_P^-2 finite-cell theorem is claimed.

rows.certificate: Finite cells, incomplete endpoints, q-family summation, physical normalization, and quadratic residuals remain open.
rows.claim: The exact symbol cancellation is not promoted to the RH bridge.
rows.proof_boundary: No grouped h2, signed-flow, Xi, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize theorem is claimed.
